pages.text: $(l)One mod at a time$()$(br)$(thing)Immersive Engineering$() first: build multiblocks and hit them with the $(item)Engineer's Hammer$(). Steady power unlocks $(thing)Applied Energistics$(); a running network unlocks $(thing)PneumaticCraft$().
A coke oven bakes coal into coal coke. A blast furnace turns iron and coke into $(item)steel$().
A controller, a drive and a storage cell: digital storage. MEGA Cells and AE2 Things lift its limits.

$(l)The gate$()$(br)Two $(item)HV Capacitors$(), fully charged by your own generators. Diesel from oil is fastest; windmills and alternators get there slowly.$(br2)$(thing)Occultism$() opens as a darker path alongside.
